title: Fairness for Servicemembers and their Families Act of 2025
official_title: An Act to amend title 38, United States Code, to require the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to periodically review the automatic maximum coverage under the Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance program and the Veterans' Group Life Insurance program, and for other purposes.
likelihoodReason: Became Public Law 119-54 on December 12, 2025. Passed the House on April 7, 2025 and the Senate on November 20, 2025.
summary: Requires the VA to review every five years whether the maximum automatic coverage under military and veterans' group life insurance has kept pace with inflation, and report to Congress.
brief: Requires the VA to review SGLI and VGLI maximum coverage against inflation every five years and report to Congress.

top_lines.headline: Group Life Insurance Coverage Review
subs: VA must review SGLI and VGLI maximum coverage every 5 years
Benchmark: $500,000 adjusted by average CPI change over 5 years
Results reported to the Veterans' Affairs Committees

items.main: Names the Act the “Fairness for Servicemembers and their Families Act of 2025”.
items.detail: Short-title section — citation name only; no substantive effect.

sections.label: Section 2 — Periodic Review of Automatic Maximum Coverage Under Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance and Veterans' Group Life Insurance

items.main: Requires the VA to review, every five years starting January 1, 2026, the automatic maximum coverage under SGLI and VGLI.
items.detail: Adds Section 1980B to title 38. The Secretary compares the maximum coverage amount in Section 1967(a)(3)(A)(i) to a benchmark equal to $500,000 adjusted by the average percentage change in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding five fiscal years, and reports the results to the House and Senate Committees on Veterans' Affairs as a guide for possible coverage increases.

gaps: The bill requires a review against an inflation benchmark but does not itself raise the maximum coverage amount.
It directs the review to serve as a guide for increases but does not require the VA to act on the findings.

featured_quotes.name: Ms. Strickland
featured_quotes.text: Mr. Speaker, I rise to express my support for my bill, H.R. 970, the Fairness for Servicemembers and their Families Act of 2025. I first thank Chairmen Bost and Luttrell and Ranking Members Takano and McGarvey for working with me to get this bill to the floor. The Fairness for Servicemembers and their Families Act will help ensure that life insurance benefits for servicemembers and veterans account for changes in the economy.

added: VA 5-year review of SGLI and VGLI maximum automatic coverage against a $500,000 CPI-adjusted benchmark, reported to Congress (new Section 1980B of title 38)
